sourceData.readingMnemonic: You're riding the escalator trying to <kanji>reach</kanji> a delicious <reading>cu</reading>cumber (<ja>きゅう</ja>).
sourceData.meaningInfo: Imagine yourself on an escalator. What is up above that you’re trying to reach?
sourceData.readingInfo: Cucumbers grow on trees sometimes, so you need to take escalators to get up there and reach them.
